description: Shared UI rendered by core (the /menu context / dropdown menu). Each value reads var(--_km-menu-X, var(--km-menu-X, var(--base-…, <default>))): the component's per-instance variable (mapped by the component onto the private --_km-menu-X with no fallback) wins, then the page-wide --km-menu-X (set on :root; components never set it), then the --base-* theme, then the default.

baseVariables.name: base-main-bg
baseVariables.usage: Menu background when neither dropdown nor elevated bg is set

baseVariables.name: base-border-color
baseVariables.usage: Menu border colour (without --base-dropdown-border) and divider colour

baseVariables.name: base-text-color-3
baseVariables.usage: Shortcut hint and divider label colour

baseVariables.name: base-disabled-opacity
baseVariables.usage: Disabled item and loading row opacity

baseVariables.name: base-danger-color
baseVariables.usage: Danger item text colour; tints the danger hover background

componentVariables.name: km-menu-item-gap
componentVariables.usage: Gap between icon, label, shortcut and submenu arrow (default 8px)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-item-padding
componentVariables.usage: Item padding; also the loading row (default 6px 12px)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-hover-bg
componentVariables.usage: Item hover / focus / open-submenu background (→ --base-hover-bg, default 8% of currentColor)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-hover-color
componentVariables.usage: Item text colour on hover / focus / open submenu (default unchanged; danger and toggled items keep theirs)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-disabled-opacity
componentVariables.usage: Disabled item and loading row opacity (→ --base-disabled-opacity, default 0.65)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-danger-hover-bg
componentVariables.usage: Danger item hover background (→ --base-danger-bg-subtle, default 10% of the danger colour)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-submenu-arrow
componentVariables.usage: Submenu arrow glyph, a CSS content value (default "\25B8")
